messages:
sam: heads up — NovaPay reporting repeated 429s and big latency variance on their Dedicated pool. customer says this started ~this morning and is intermittent. :rotating_light:
lee: escalated from support. they saw a spike of 429s at 12:34 UTC and again at 12:40. ticket #NP-422. attaching customer repro steps in thread.
maya: looking into metrics now — I'm seeing pod count bounce: 2 -> 6 -> 2 multiple times in a ~10m window. latency spikes precede scale up then we immediately scale down because the queue drops.
autoscale-bot: [alert] policy:nova-pay-dedicated autoscaler triggered scale_up (2->6) at 2025-11-02T12:34:02Z reason=latency_p95>250ms threshold=200ms
jo: likely oscillation from a short-lived burst pattern + cooldown too short. cooldown currently 30s. Also smoothing window is 60s which is too aggressive for this workload.
sam: repro steps from customer (they shared):

curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X POST https://api.redwood.run/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-dedicated-1024","prompt":"<simple>"}' -H 'x-tenant-id: nova-pay' -v

They said calling in parallel with ~60 concurrent short requests (avg 10 tokens) causes the observed behavior.
maya: quick obs from runtime logs (tail):

```
2025-11-02T12:34:02Z WARN request_id=abc123 throttle=true route=nova-pay/generate latency_ms=312
2025-11-02T12:34:02Z INFO scale_event replicas 2 -> 6 reason=latency_p95>200ms
2025-11-02T12:34:08Z INFO request_id=def456 served latency_ms=120
2025-11-02T12:34:32Z INFO scale_event replicas 6 -> 2 reason=queue_empty cooldown=30s
2025-11-02T12:34:35Z ERROR request_id=ghi789 http_status=429 reason=throttled
```

jo: note how scale_down happens within same minute once queue drains — this is classic overreactive autoscale. We should increase cooldown and use a longer smoothing window for p95. Also consider min_replicas bump.
rachel: for immediate mitigation I recommend: set min_replicas=4 for nova-pay pool, cooldown=180s, smoothing_window=180s. Also enable tenant QoS isolation to throttle noisy tenants before they affect others.
lee: customer ok with mitgation, wants quick fix.
sam: plan — I'll push temp autoscaler override for tenant nova-pay to increase min_replicas and cooldown in prod-us-east. If that stabilizes in 30m, we can roll permanent config and follow up with perf tuning.
jo: long term we should: 1) add request-rate aware hysteresis, 2) add a short-term burst pool for tiny short requests, 3) expose recommended per-tenant autoscale presets.
autoscale-bot: starting config change: path=/configs/autoscaler/prod-us-east/tenants/nova-pay override=min_replicas=4,cooldown_s=180,smoothing_s=180 requested_by=sam
deploy-bot: config apply job #cj-884 submitted to prod-us-east by sam at 2025-11-02T12:41:20Z
jo: monitoring now — put a 10m alert if p95 > 300ms or 429 rate > 0.5% after change.
sam: change applied. watching logs.
maya: preliminary: within 5m after change p95 dropped from 340ms -> 180ms and 429s stopped. queue depth smoothed.
rachel: I'll message customer with status update and ETA for follow-up. keep ticket open for 24h.
sam: leaving this thread open. if flapping returns we'll do the burst-pool rollout and tenant isolation work. thanks all. :thumbsup:
